policies.title: Singapore short visit
notes: Ordinary Chinese passports have a published exemption of up to 30 days.
Confirm general entry requirements and the visit pass issued on arrival. This source does not establish an exact day-counting convention.

policies.title: China short visit
notes: Ordinary Singapore passports have a published exemption of up to 30 days.
Mutual-exemption guidance also describes a 90-day cap in 180 days and excludes stays under certain other permissions. Exact applicability and counting remain reference-only.

policies.title: Japan short visit
notes: Singapore is listed for short-stay visa exemption with 90 days upon landing permission.
Entry conditions and day counting require confirmation. No cumulative Japan rule is inferred.

policies.title: Schengen short visit
notes: General short-stay limit only; entry and exit days count.
Exclude stays authorised by a residence permit or long-stay visa where applicable. Personal grants, bilateral exceptions and travel authorisations require separate review.
Membership is supplied only from 1 January 2025. Earlier membership is unknown in this catalog.

policies.title: Korea transit through the US route
notes: Reviewed subset: Chinese ordinary passport and a valid US visa attached as a sticker, with a direct US-to-third-country route through Korea or the reverse.
Confirmed departure within 30 days and the listed immigration-history conditions are required. Intermediate routes require individual review; a known stay exceeding three days does not match.
The boundary counting convention is unverified. No calculated admission deadline is supplied. Residence cards, electronic documents and other issuers are outside this subset.

policies.title: Indonesia visa on arrival
notes: The official list includes China for electronic visa on arrival. Arrival applications use designated immigration checkpoints.

A valid national passport with at least six months remaining and a return or onward ticket are listed requirements. Confirm the applicable visa type, checkpoint and authorised stay. No unverified duration is calculated.

policies.title: UK electronic travel authorisation
notes: The ETA nationality rules include Singapore for travel from 8 January 2025. An ETA is advance travel permission, not a grant of admission.

Exemptions can apply to British or Irish passport holders and people with existing UK permission. Confirm the route, purpose and applicable status. No fixed-day stay deadline is inferred from the visitor-month guidance.

policies.title: Qatar short visit
notes: Passport validity of at least three months from arrival is required for this route. Check current entry conditions.
Stays beyond 30 days require approval from Qatar authorities. Work, study and residence require separate permission.

policies.title: Oman short visit
notes: A passport valid for at least six months, return ticket, confirmed hotel, health insurance and sufficient funds are required.
This exemption does not require a third-country visa. The 14-day stay cannot be extended or converted to residence.

policies.title: Thailand short visit
notes: The bilateral exemption allows up to 30 days per stay and 90 days in any 180-day period.
Complete a new, free Thailand Digital Arrival Card before each entry using the official submission window.
Residence, work, study and other activities requiring prior approval are separate. Extensions depend on Thai Immigration.

policies.title: Malaysia short visit
notes: The exemption allows up to 30 days per entry and 90 days within a 180-day period. Re-entry can be limited by the cumulative allowance.
A passport valid for at least six months is required. Have onward travel and accommodation details ready.
Complete the Malaysia Digital Arrival Card before entry; use the official portal for its current submission window.
Stays before 17 July 2025 and stays under other facilities, such as a visa or APEC card, are excluded from this bilateral quota. Check your remaining allowance with Malaysian Immigration.

policies.title: Indonesia visa on arrival
notes: B1 is a single-entry visa on arrival for up to 30 days at designated checkpoints. An e-VOA can be obtained before travel.
A passport valid for at least six months and a return or onward ticket are required. The published B1 fee is IDR 500,000.
One extension may be requested, for up to 60 days in total. The e-VOA's 90-day entry validity is separate from the permitted stay.

policies.title: Nepal tourist visa on arrival
notes: Tourist visas on arrival offer 15, 30 or 90 days at TIA and other designated entry points. Chinese nationals qualify for a gratis visa.
Use a machine-readable passport valid for at least six months. Complete the arrival application and visa issuance with Immigration.
Tourist stays, including approved extensions, are limited to 150 days per visa year (January to December). Check the duration issued on your visa.

policies.title: Maldives short visit
notes: Use an MRZ passport with at least one month remaining; extended-validity passports are not accepted. Each child needs their own passport.
Bring a confirmed return itinerary, prepaid registered accommodation and sufficient funds, or Immigration-approved sponsorship. Meet onward-destination requirements.
Submit the free IMUGA declaration within 96 hours before arrival. A yellow-fever certificate is required when the travel history triggers that requirement.

policies.title: Schengen short visit
notes: Apply for a short-stay Schengen visa before travel unless an existing visa or qualifying residence document covers your visit.
Use the validity, entries and stay allowance on your visa. The general 90/180-day ceiling is not a personal visa grant.
Qualifying Schengen residence permits, long-stay visas and EU-family residence cards may change the requirement. Select your document; overseas French territories have separate rules.

policies.title: Schengen short-stay visa
notes: Apply for a Schengen visa before travel unless a valid visa or qualifying residence document covers your visit.
Use the validity, entries and stay allowance on your document. The general short-stay ceiling is not a visa grant.

policies.title: Schengen visa-free short visit
notes: Short tourism is generally visa-free. Check your passport and entry requirements before traveling.
Visitors generally have a 90-day limit in any 180 days. Existing visas, residence status and earlier visits may affect your stay.

policies.title: Schengen biometric-passport exemption
notes: Visa-free travel requires a qualifying biometric passport. Other passports may require a visa.
Check ICAO document standards where required. Qualifying Serbian Coordination Directorate biometric passports are included.

policies.title: Hong Kong SAR passport exemption
notes: Visa-free short tourism requires a Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport. Other Hong Kong travel documents do not establish this exemption.

policies.title: Macao SAR passport exemption
notes: Visa-free short tourism requires a Macao SAR passport. Other Macao travel documents may require a visa.

policies.title: Taiwan passport identity-number exemption
notes: Visa-free short tourism requires a passport issued by Taiwan that includes an identity card number. Other passports may require a visa.

policies.title: Nauru visa-waiver agreement condition
notes: Apply for a visa unless an EU visa-waiver agreement covers your passport.
Confirm the current requirement with the destination consulate before traveling.

policies.title: European travel rights
notes: Travel with a valid passport or accepted national identity card under your EU, EEA or Swiss citizenship rights.
Check residence or work requirements for a longer stay.

policies.title: UK visit visa: usual national-passport route
notes: These listed national passports usually require a visit visa before short tourism. The China row means a mainland PRC passport; HKSAR and Macao SAR passports have separate references.

Existing UK permission, British or Irish citizenship, qualifying documents and organised school trips can change the usual route. Use the official guidance for your circumstances; this reference does not replace your saved permission.
Standard visits are usually up to six calendar months. This is not 180 days, an admission grant or a promise of re-entry; frequent visits must not make the UK your main home.

policies.title: UK ETA: usual national-passport route
notes: These listed national passports usually require an ETA before short tourism. An ETA permits travel and does not guarantee entry or two years of continuous stay.

Existing UK permission, British or Irish citizenship, qualifying documents and organised school trips can change the usual route. Use the official guidance for your circumstances; this reference does not replace your saved permission.

Qualifying lawful residents of Ireland arriving from Ireland, Guernsey, Jersey or the Isle of Man may be ETA-exempt; Irish residence alone does not waive a visa requirement. Standard visits are usually up to six calendar months. This is not 180 days, an admission grant or a promise of re-entry; frequent visits must not make the UK your main home.

policies.title: UK ETA for HKSAR and Macao SAR passports
notes: The usual short-tourism ETA route is for a passport issued by the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region or Macao Special Administrative Region. It does not cover a mainland PRC or BN(O) passport.

Existing UK permission, British or Irish citizenship, qualifying documents and organised school trips can change the usual route. Use the official guidance for your circumstances; this reference does not replace your saved permission.
Standard visits are usually up to six calendar months. This is not 180 days, an admission grant or a promise of re-entry; frequent visits must not make the UK your main home.

policies.title: UK entry: check the Taiwan passport
notes: A Taiwan-issued passport containing the national identification-card number normally uses the ETA route; without that number, the visa-national requirement applies. This app does not record that document attribute.

Existing UK permission, British or Irish citizenship, qualifying documents and organised school trips can change the usual route. Use the official guidance for your circumstances; this reference does not replace your saved permission.
Standard visits are usually up to six calendar months. This is not 180 days, an admission grant or a promise of re-entry; frequent visits must not make the UK your main home.

policies.title: Irish citizens: Common Travel Area
notes: Irish citizens generally do not need permission to enter or remain in the UK under the Common Travel Area. Deportation orders, exclusion decisions and international travel bans are exceptions.
This is a citizenship right, not a six-month tourist grant. It does not automatically apply to non-Irish family members or to a person merely resident in Ireland.

policies.title: UK entry: check British citizenship and passport class
notes: British citizens have right of abode and need no UK visa or ETA. Use a valid British passport, or another accepted proof such as a certificate of entitlement; this app does not identify British nationality classes.

A GB country code alone does not establish British citizenship or right of abode. BN(O) and British overseas territories citizen passports are ETA-exempt, while other British nationality classes need their own document and status checks.

No visitor duration or unlimited-stay entitlement is inferred for an unspecified British nationality class. Dual British or Irish citizens cannot obtain an ETA and must use an accepted proof of citizenship or entitlement.

policies.title: UK entry: check the Vatican or Holy See document
notes: The ETA National List names Vatican City. A separate visa-list exception names Holy See Service, Temporary Service and Diplomatic passports; this ordinary-passport reference does not apply that special-document exception.
Confirm the exact national passport or Holy See travel-document class and any existing UK permission before choosing an ETA or another route. The document class is not represented here.
Standard visits are usually up to six calendar months. This is not 180 days, an admission grant or a promise of re-entry; frequent visits must not make the UK your main home.

policies.title: Japan visit visa: usual national-passport route
notes: These ordinary passport issuers are outside the current short-stay exemption table and separate qualified references. A visa is normally required before travel; nationality alone does not establish passport acceptance or admission.
JAPAN eVISA is an advance visa, not visa-free entry or visa on arrival. Application eligibility depends on residence, itinerary and local procedures, not nationality alone.

Existing Japanese nationality or valid re-entry permission can change the route. Check your documents and the Japanese mission serving your residence. Visa validity and a permitted stay are different.

policies.title: Japan short-stay visa exemption
notes: The official table lists these national passports for short-stay exemption, with an initial 90-day stay upon landing permission for qualifying tourism.
Visa exemption does not guarantee entry. Your landing permission sets the actual stay; this reference never renews an admission or replaces a saved permission.

policies.title: Japan short stay: extension requires approval
notes: The initial landing stay is 90 days. The bilateral arrangement may permit a longer stay only after an extension application to the regional immigration authority before the current stay expires.
Do not treat the six-month arrangement as an automatic 180-day grant. Employment and other non-visitor activities need their own route.
Visa exemption does not guarantee entry. Your landing permission sets the actual stay; this reference never renews an admission or replaces a saved permission.

policies.title: Japan short visit for Brunei passports
notes: The official short-stay table states 30 days upon landing permission for qualifying Brunei passport holders.
Visa exemption does not guarantee entry. Your landing permission sets the actual stay; this reference never renews an admission or replaces a saved permission.

policies.title: Japan entry: ICAO ePassport required

The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: check the Malaysian ePassport
notes: The exemption is for ICAO-compliant Malaysian ePassports, with 90 days upon qualifying landing permission. Other passport holders are advised to obtain a visa and may face strict examination or refusal.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Indonesian passport registration
notes: The 15-day exemption requires an ICAO-compliant Indonesian ePassport registered with a Japanese mission in Indonesia before travel.
Registration lasts three years or until passport expiry, whichever is sooner. That registration validity is not permission for a continuous three-year stay.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Qatari passport registration
notes: The 30-day exemption requires an ICAO-compliant ordinary Qatari ePassport registered with a Japanese overseas mission before departure.
Registration lasts three years or until passport expiry, whichever is sooner. A new passport or name change requires registration again; longer stays or employment require a visa.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Taiwan passport ID condition
notes: The short-stay exemption applies only to a Taiwan passport containing a personal ID number. The qualifying initial landing stay is 90 days.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Hong Kong passport condition
notes: The exemption is limited to an HKSAR passport, or a BN(O) passport holder with the right of residence in Hong Kong. It is not a mainland PRC passport exemption; the qualifying initial stay is 90 days.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Macao SAR passport condition
notes: The exemption is limited to a passport issued by the Macao SAR of the PRC. The qualifying initial landing stay is 90 days.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.
Visa exemption does not guarantee entry. Your landing permission sets the actual stay; this reference never renews an admission or replaces a saved permission.

policies.title: Japan entry: check the Uruguayan passport version
notes: Japan does not recognise the new Uruguayan ordinary passport version without place of birth. The old version remains eligible for the 90-day exemption, including old-version passports issued after 16 April 2025.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.
Visa exemption does not guarantee entry. Your landing permission sets the actual stay; this reference never renews an admission or replaces a saved permission.

policies.title: Japan entry: check British passport class
notes: The UK exemption does not cover every British nationality or issuing territory. The Japanese Embassy lists British Overseas Citizens, British Subjects and British Overseas Territories passports as requiring a visa.

A qualifying British citizen passport normally has an initial 90-day landing stay; any longer stay under the bilateral arrangement requires an approved extension before expiry. The separate BN(O) rule requires Hong Kong residence rights.
The app does not record this passport condition. Confirm the exact document and applicable route before travel; a nationality selection does not establish eligibility.

policies.title: Japan entry: Colombian visa guidance
notes: Colombia is outside the 74-entry table, but MOFA and the Japanese Embassy advise ordinary Colombian visitors to obtain a visa to avoid strict examination, refusal or boarding problems. This is preserved as qualified guidance, not unconditional visa-free entry.
Confirm the current document and visa route with the Japanese mission before travel. No admission or stay is inferred.

policies.title: Japanese citizens returning to Japan
notes: Japanese nationals travelling with a valid Japanese passport do not need a Japanese visa. This citizenship reference is not a foreign visitor stay grant.
Confirm your Japanese nationality and travel documentation. No tourist duration or individual entry entitlement is calculated.

policies.title: Japan entry: confirm North Korean travel restrictions
notes: General visa guidance does not establish admissibility for this nationality. MOFA describes special North Korea travel restrictions, but the current individual entry route has not been verified for this reference.
Contact a Japanese diplomatic mission before making plans. This unresolved reference grants no visa eligibility, admission or stay.
